text:
maria: Quick onboarding check for Helene-X2 — putting this thread for async sign-offs. We have weights uploaded and a small tokenizer quirk to call out. Please skim: s3://redwood-models/helene-x2/v1/weights.tar.gz and s3://redwood-models/helene-x2/v1/tokenizer.zip. Draft customer note at /internal/docs/drafts/helene-x2-announcement.md (will copy to public once approved).

raj: Checking weights now. Confirmed tarball and sha256: 9f2b... matches. I ran `model.inspect --path s3://... --summary` and looked good. No missing layers.

sam: Quick flag — tokenizer has an odd BOS token id of 0 that collides with padding in some of our runtime checks. On a few samples I saw inputs get trimmed. Repro: `tokenizer.encode('Hello') -> [0, 154, 23]` (0 is BOS). Can we force `add_bos=False` in our serving tokenizer wrapper?

maria: Good catch. That explains the short-input trimming in our local smoke tests. Raj — can you add a pretokenize step to drop leading BOS if present? Also we need config validation: model.config.max_seq_len is 2048 but tokenizer.model_max_length is 4096. That mismatch will break KV cache allocation in the runtime.

raj: Will add the pretokenize guard. For the seq_len mismatch: looks like the model was fine with 2048 training context; tokenizer was exported with max_length defaulted. Which value should we declare as canonical?

olivia: For customer-facing messaging, call out the capacity as 2k context natively. We can mention experimental long-context via chunking/streaming but not GA. So canonical should be 2048. Docs should warn about feeding >2048 causing truncation or increased latency with chunking.

lin: I'll update the internal draft docs and the public blurb. Proposed capability notes (short bullets):
- Great for code generation and short technical explanations.
- Strong token-level coherence up to ~1.5k tokens, degrades past 2k for long-narrative copy.
- Known tokenizer quirk: leading BOS token id 0 (recommend stripping in client).
- Safety: tends to be conservative on offensive content, but may hallucinate dates in long historical prompts.

sam: For serving config, I'm attaching the minimal change to validators:
```
model:
  name: helene-x2
  version: v1
  max_seq_len: 2048
tokenizer:
  add_bos: false
  model_max_length: 2048
```
We should enforce that model.max_seq_len <= tokenizer.model_max_length in the config linter.

deploy-bot: Deploy check started for helene-x2/v1 on staging cluster 'dedicated-pool-4' (job id 5132). Logs: https://deploys.local/job/5132

maria: Sam/Lin — can you two confirm the linter change and doc wording by EOD? I want to publish the customer-facing announcement tomorrow morning PST. Also need a short 'what it's good at' sentence for the public note.

sam: Linter patch ready — PR 8423 with unit tests added. It fails CI if model.max_seq_len > tokenizer.model_max_length. cc @lin for wording.

lin: Wording suggestion for public one-liner: "Helene-X2 (v1) — high-throughput code and assistant tasks with a 2k context window; optimal for short-to-medium prompts and code generation." Keep it clear for product pages.

olivia: +1 on that wording. Add a second sentence: "Known quirks: requires client-side stripping of an exported BOS token; we recommend using Redwood SDK v0.9+ which applies this automatically."

maria: Perfect. Docs and linter approvals pending; pinging @sam for CR on the validator and @raj for the tokenizer wrapper change. If both green, I'll flip the draft to public and schedule the announcement. :rocket:

sam: CRed the linter, small nits addressed.

raj: Pushed tokenizer pretokenize guard to staging branch, included a test mapping leading 0->drop. Verified with smoke harness — no more trimming.

docs-bot: Draft created: sources/internal/docs/drafts/helene-x2-announcement.md (editor: lin). Public copy will be created under /docs/models after approval.

maria: Thank you — final checklist: 
- [x] weights present in S3 and sha verified (raj)
- [x] tokenizer guard in staging (raj)
- [x] config linter PR (sam)
- [x] docs draft updated (lin)
- [ ] legal quick-check on branding (olivia)
- [ ] final publish + announcement (maria)

olivia: Legal review requested via workflow. ETA 24 hrs. If delayed we can do a soft-announcement to existing customers but hold public blog until signed off.

maria: Noted. If legal blocks, we'll still flip the model to hosted beta with a short private note. Thanks all! :white_check_mark:
